summary_en: Meiko Kensetsu executed an off-market purchase of 40,000 shares at 1,877 yen per share via N-NET3 on November 6, 2026, for a total of 75.08 million yen, representing 0.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares through off-market purchase transaction (N-NET3)
translation_en_brief: On November 5, 2026, Meiko Kensetsu's board of directors approved the execution of a block purchase under an existing buyback authorization. The company executed an off-market purchase via N-NET3 on November 6, 2026, acquiring 40,000 shares at 1,877 yen per share (the closing price as of November 5), for a total consideration of 75.08 million yen. This represents 0.2% of the company's issued shares excluding treasury stock. The purchase was executed during the morning trading session and was contingent on matching sell orders at the stated price. Following this execution, the company plans to continue purchasing shares under the remaining authorization of 134,000 shares (0.53% of outstanding shares) and 184.92 million yen through the end of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, utilizing both N-NET3 off-market purchases and ordinary market purchases on the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
